summary: postinstall fetches and installs an executable from a hardcoded bare IP with TLS verification disabled
details: The npm postinstall lifecycle script downloads a platform tarball from a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/onecode-<ver>/onecode-linux-x64-<ver>.tgz), extracts it, chmods the binary executable, and hardlinks it into the launcher's bin/ directory to serve as the `onecode` CLI. The fetch is performed with `rejectUnauthorized: false`, disabling TLS certificate verification, and no hash or signature verification is applied to the downloaded artifact. The source is a raw IPv4 address, not a documented publisher domain or CDN, so the delivered bytes cannot be attributed to the package publisher and can be substituted by any party controlling that IP or capable of intercepting the connection. Installing the package causes an unverified remote binary to be placed and executable on the installer's host as part of the default install flow.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
